title: Grateful Dead Live at Manor Downs on 1982-07-31
lineage: modified Nak CM-700's > Sony TC-D5M > Nak Dragon > HHB CDR 800 > CDR > Samsung SW-232B > EAC v0.9 beta 4 > CD Wave > shntool > SHN

ai_review.summary: Clean‑crisp audience (AUD) recording captures a high‑energy 1982 show with a smoking Scarlet > Fire and standout Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a clear, crisp AUD source that lets the fierce, inspired playing shine through. Reviewers rave about the second set—especially the blistering Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain segue and an unforgettable Morning Dew—and note tight group dynamics throughout. While one reviewer called it “a little Phil‑lite,” overall the performance is described as high‑energy and tightly executed.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and repeated praise for both the musical performance and the clear AUD recording push the overall rating into the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Listeners note clean, crisp audio with solid balance; a few call it "pretty good" and mention a slight Phil‑lite mix, but no major dropouts or muffiness reported.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted as tight and energetic; overall set praised for seamless transitions and inspired playing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for “going to town,” holding the band off before Truckin', and delivering a powerful guitar performance.
band_member_comments.Phil: One reviewer notes it’s a bit "Phil‑lite" for their taste, but no major criticisms of his bass playing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned alongside Brent as working the songs tightly; Bob’s rhythm work is appreciated.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland highlighted for contributing strongly to the sound during the second set.
